1_pure_mcp_chat_delivery.rule: Pure MCP or single python helper, output to file + reply, no shell git push

3_shell_git_push.rule: Python helper does git push via local PAT file; needs secret tool for Cloud

special.rule: KEEP LOCAL (1, 3) or PILOT (18) or REDESIGN (24)

migration_order: 1. PILOT (cron #18, Sun 02:00 ET) - already staged, probes env vars + sandbox persistence
2. Set GITHUB_TOKEN via secret tool (between pilot and Bucket 1)
3. Stage all 20 Bucket 1 crons as chat-delivery prompts
4. Design cron #24 X audit (decide on export source for Cloud)
5. Patch Bucket 3 crons (11, 21) to read GITHUB_TOKEN from secret tool env
6. Skip crons #1 (audit log) and #3 (watchdog) - keep local only
skill_hosting_recommendation: raw.githubusercontent.com for version control + Cloud sandbox independence
